question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **concern.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Concern**: A matter of interest, seriousness, or importance to someone. (किसी के लिए रुचि, गंभीरता या महत्व का विषय)
 
• **Consternate**: A feeling of strong annoyance and anger. (तीव्र झुंझलाहट और क्रोध की भावना)
 
• **Bridle**: To hold back from or control in doing something. (किसी काम को करने से रोकना या नियंत्रित करना)
 
• **Poise**: Calm confidence in a person's way of behaving, or quality of grace. (शिष्टता; किसी व्यक्ति के व्यवहार करने के तरीके, या अनुग्रह की गुणवत्ता में शांत विश्वास)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**Concern**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: The findings come in the wake of increased **worry **among parents, physicians, health organizations, and politicians about young people being harmed by cyberbullying and social media...
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Complete passage: *Four of the most popular forms i.e. Facebook, Twitter, Snapchat, and Instagram of social media (1) inflict__ great damage to young people’s mental health. These four platforms have a negative effect because they can (2) __exacerbate__ children’s and young people’s body image worries, and worsen bullying, sleep problems, anxiety, depression, and loneliness. The findings follow growing **(3) __concern__*** *among politicians, health bodies, doctors, and parents about young people suffering harm as a result of cyberbullying and social media (4)_________ feelings of self-loathing and leading them to commit suicide. However, the leader of the UK’s psychiatrists said these findings were too simplistic and they (5)________ blamed social media for the complex reasons why the mental health of so many young people is suffering.*

1b2:T100f,

The correct answer is: **reinforcing.**
